# Vendored browser dependency

- TradingView Lightweight Charts 5.2.0, standalone production IIFE.
- Source package: https://registry.npmjs.org/lightweight-charts/-/lightweight-charts-5.2.0.tgz
- Package SHA512: `ey3Vas8UhV06ni+LT9TA1nEe4y8So4Mi6CL/oarNHFMyTktz/xy8e8+oh04Q//eO3t6etvFXgayz2fClyFQb5w==`
- Apache-2.0 license and TradingView NOTICE are included. The bundled fancy-canvas 2.1.0
  dependency is MIT-licensed; its license is copied from the official TradingView source repository.
- No npm lifecycle scripts were executed. The browser loads this bundle from the local server;
  there is no remote script dependency or TradingView market-data connection.
- Visible attribution and a link to TradingView are retained below the dashboard chart.

Sources: https://github.com/tradingview/lightweight-charts/tree/v5.2.0 and
https://github.com/tradingview/fancy-canvas/blob/master/LICENSE.
